Evidence & scope

Creator-maintained family/release documentation received separate AI source-content review of construction, label origin, format, evaluation conditions and stated access/license limitations. This is documentation review, not download or independent recount of corpus rows. The pinned release and parent family remain distinct; rights conflicts and version-specific unknowns are preserved in approved assertions.
